quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has several turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that the space above the road is low. Tall vehicles may not fit under it.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign tells you to pass on the side shown by the arrow. An island, median, or barrier is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop. Wait for all vehicles and pedestrians to clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange. This sign warns you that construction or maintenance work is happening ahead. Slow down and be extra careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that a side road is coming. Watch for vehicles entering from that side road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, but you may not always need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always come to a complete stop. Only go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid accidents.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, it means the rider:
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals when turn signals are not available. A left arm bent at the elbow pointing upward means the rider is turning right or changing lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The bridge above has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge above has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the bridge ahead has limited height. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (in this case, 13 feet, 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn right or continue straight.
You can turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn right or continue straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you must either turn right or continue straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers which direction they must drive on a one-way street. Drivers must follow the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When you extend your left arm straight out to the left, it means you plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A sign with a red circle and red slash through it means the action is not allowed. Right turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: This chevron sign shows that the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow (in this case, to the left). You may see several of these signs placed along a curve.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead turns sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What should you do at an intersection with a yield sign?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for road hazards. This sign warns you about a T intersection where you may need to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road ahead becomes a divided highway. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign tell you?

options.text: It warns you about conditions on or near the road.
It helps you find cities and towns ahead.
It tells you about traffic laws.
It tells you about road construction.

questions.correctAnswerText: It warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They alert you to conditions on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs display traffic laws that you must obey. This sign means right turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign alerts you to a divided highway coming up.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make U-turns where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to continue driving in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for road hazards. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean when riding in a group?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider extends their left arm down with palm facing back, all riders should stop.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is ahead. The road splits into two separate one-way roads. You must stay on the right side.

questions.question: The speed limit sign shows:

options.text: The exact speed you must drive at to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed in ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed in all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed in ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: The speed limit is the highest legal speed for that road. You should drive slower if conditions are not ideal, such as bad weather or wet roads.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You can go if the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are going the wrong way on a one-way street. You risk a head-on crash. Turn around safely.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign marks a low ground railroad crossing. The railroad tracks cross at a steep angle. Low vehicles may drag on or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign shows an intersection is coming. Watch for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a sharp right turn on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is merging into your lane from the right.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm and extends their index finger?

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: This hand signal tells the group to move into a single line of riders.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it rains.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill slope is coming.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, whether there's a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Watch for children near the school. Be prepared to stop for them. Always yield to pedestrians in crosswalks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: The red circle with a slash through it means the action is not allowed. U-turns are forbidden where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right side of the divider.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: This hand signal is used in group riding to tell other riders to follow.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes are about to become one. Traffic must merge together.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A school crossing sign warns you that a school crossing is nearby.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign has a yellow background with black markings. It warns you that the road ahead has curves. Slow down and be prepared to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming. Be ready to adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers they cannot park in this area. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign has a yellow background with black markings. It warns that the divided highway is ending soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest speed you can legally drive on this road. In rain, snow, ice, or other bad conditions, you must drive slower than the posted speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign has a yellow background with black markings. It warns that a steep hill is ahead. Adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a lane is ending. Be ready for traffic to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When turning left at a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic and turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign (with the arrow) shows where bicycles cross or ride. Drive carefully because bicycles use this area regularly.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, it means:

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: The road ahead makes a sharp turn (in this case, to the right). Slow down as you would for a turn at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign with a traffic signal tells drivers that left-turning traffic must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has three or more curves.

questions.question: This sign warns you that ahead is:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or turns, and keep more distance from other vehicles.

questions.question: This sign shows:
questions.explanation: This sign means a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down. Trains cannot move out of your way, so you must wait for them to pass.

questions.question: From bottom to top, traffic lights are ordered:
questions.explanation: Traffic lights go from bottom to top: green, yellow, then red.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is near.
Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach this sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if needed.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two-way traffic is coming.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane is ending.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: These spaces are for people with disability permits.
Traffic must turn in the direction of the arrow.
These lanes are for buses and carpools.

questions.correctAnswerText: These spaces are for people with disability permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disability permits.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Construction workers are on the road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a rider bends their left arm at the elbow and points it upward, it means they plan to turn right or change lanes to the right. You can use hand signals instead of or along with your turn signals.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with the palm up and swings their arm upward, it signals riders to increase their speed. Hand signals are important when riding in a group.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Be careful and watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This circular sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming. Watch for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that a traffic light is ahead. Be ready for red lights, yellow lights, and cross traffic.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Any eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely. Check for pedestrians and other traffic before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot drive in this direction. Turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road curves to the right first, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road is one-way. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you that traffic may come from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions. This sign alerts you that traffic will merge from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a roundabout is coming. Enter slowly and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This center lane is only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead. A road is joining from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions. This sign alerts you that a stop sign is coming. Get ready to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Yield to all vehicles and pedestrians. Go only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm down and swings it down to their side, it tells the group to slow down.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: This road sign indicates:

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed for exiting a highway, such as 30 mph.

questions.question: On the freeway, you see a "Merging traffic" sign. You should:

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When traffic is merging, make room if you can. Move to another lane if it is safe and empty.

questions.question: This sign means that:

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or very close to the road ahead. Drive carefully through work zones.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: When an operator's left arm is extended straight out to the left, it means the operator:
questions.explanation: When an operator extends their left arm straight out, it signals a left turn or lane change to the left.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a sharp turn ahead. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean stop. Come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way before proceeding when it is safe.

questions.question: This green arrow on a lane use control signal means:

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
A divided highway is starting. Slow down to 35 mph.
Merge ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
The road winds ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right. You must slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign, which is 35 mph in this case.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
Specific turns are allowed from specific lanes only.
Drivers in both lanes must merge carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. The left lane is reserved for buses and cars with a driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: This is a triangular Yield sign. When you see it, slow down to check for traffic. Let pedestrians and cross traffic go first. Only stop if you need to.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what must you do?

options.text: You can continue forward or exit from your current lane.
You can stay in your lane and continue forward.
You must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means this lane will leave the highway. If you stay in this lane, you must exit. You can change to another lane to continue forward instead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They tell you about hazards ahead. This sign warns that a traffic light is coming. Get ready for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this warning sign tell drivers?

options.text: The right lane is ending. Move to the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending. Move to the left lane.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane is closing. Traffic in the right lane must move to the left lane.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: You can pass a slow vehicle if it is quick.
You can pass if you know the road.
You can pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white rectangles with black markings. You must obey them. This sign means passing other vehicles is not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it is wet. Drive carefully in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves right and then curves left. Slow down so you can safely handle these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs tell drivers to slow down at intersections. Be ready to stop for other drivers or pedestrians. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Red is always on top and green on the bottom for vertical signals. Red is always on the left and green on the right for horizontal signals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: This shape and color sign is a _____________ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a lane is ending or the road is narrowing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes very slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you must stay on the right side to avoid a hazard ahead.
